verses.1: And on that day, Mikhael the great prophet will stand over your people. It will be a difficult time, because until that time, your people had no knowledge of this. And on that day, all those who are listed in the book will be freed from their suffering.
verses.2: And many of those who live in the land of Apar will be raised to eternal life. And those who live in the land of Harav will be subjected to eternal suffering.
verses.3: And the minds will shine like the brightness of the sky. And the righteous will be like stars forever and ever.
verses.4: And you, Daniel, complete these words and end this book. Until then, many things will still remain unresolved, and knowledge will continue to grow.
verses.5: And I saw that Daniel stood there, with two others standing beside him. One of them was standing by the side of the sun, and the other was standing by the side of the moon.
verses.6: And he said to the man who was in the wilderness: “The stars are shining from above the heavens, until death comes.”
verses.7: And I heard the man who was crying out in pain, from above the waters of the sea. He raised his right hand and his left hand toward the heavens. He continued to cry out for eternity, because at appointed times, the sacred people will be punished by God. All of these things will happen.
verses.8: And I have heard this, but I do not understand it. So I said, “Lord, what does this mean?”
verses.9: And Daniel said, “The words are sealed and hidden until the time comes.”
verses.10: They will be revealed and united together. Many will be destroyed, while the wicked will be punished. But all the wicked will not be understood by anyone; only those who are wise will understand them.
verses.11: And from the time of its permanent destruction, let it be decreed that it will remain in that state for thousands of days and ninety days.
verses.12: When that day comes, it will be thousands of three hundred and fifteen days away.
verses.13: And you shall go to the cross, and lie down, and stand before your Lord at the right side of the cross.
